current_concerns.primary_problems: Restricting food and counting calories since around age 18; ongoing preoccupation with body shape; difficulty eating around other people and avoidance of doing so; these concerns occupy much of the day and make other areas difficult, including relationships; anxiety and worry, especially before planning or eating food and when eating with other people; also worries quickly about other things; frequent tiredness and generally low mood, with some days being particularly difficult; continued preoccupation with calories despite some weight improvement; planning food in advance is distressing.
current_concerns.goals: Be able to eat a meal with friends without planning for it several days in advance.
